verdict.rationale: Stripe's platform pricing tools let a platform set pricing strategies for connected accounts' payment processing without code, and charges can be split between platform and sellers, so the sell-rate side of the story is documented. The buy rate shows up only through community-cited fees (30¢ + 2.9% and a 0.5% payout fee), and one user was confused about how that fee structure works. Missing for 10: a first-party documented platform buy rate, interchange-level or per-transaction cost visibility for managing the spread, and independent hands-on corroboration of the pricing tools.
